dedupe_keys.name: craft ccafs regional agricultural forecasting toolbox for gridded crop yield forecasting and risk analysis

description: A software platform for regional crop yield forecasting, risk analysis and climate impact studies. The paper abstract in Environmental Modelling and Software (2019, Shelia, Hansen, Sharda, Porter, Aggarwal, Wilkerson and Hoogenboom) says CRAFT runs the pre-installed crop models DSSAT, APSIM and SARRA-H on gridded inputs at 5 and 30 arc-minutes, together with the Climate Predictability Tool for seasonal climate forecasts, and produces scenarios, maps and interactive visualisations, with case studies for wheat and rice in South Asia. A CCAFS working paper (Gyawali and co-authors, 2018) says CRAFT was used in Nepal from November 2014 to December 2016 to forecast wheat and paddy yields in season, with forecasts close to Ministry estimates, and was being tested at sub-national level. Licence: not stated for the resource; the describing article (doi:10.1016/j.envsoft.2019.02.006) is CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0. Access is free of charge. Coverage is South Asia in the cases read. Caveats: running it needs gridded weather, soil and management data. For simulation it gives in-season yield forecasts that warn of harvest shortfalls after drought or floods. Related catalogue records include DSSAT and APSIM.
